name: Banff National Park
tagline: Banff — Lake Louise shoreline and townsite views; not the whole Rockies.
blurb: Canadian Rockies day — lakeshore loop and one overlook, heat-and-crowd smart.
slice: Lake Louise shoreline / Banff town views
art: Banff Lake Louise turquoise glacial lake and snowy peaks at golden hour empty shore

practical.ticket_note: Parks Canada discovery pass or day fee; parking fills early at Louise.
practical.transit_note: Banff town + shuttle options to Lake Louise in peak season.
practical.energy_note: Altitude mild; cold water; crowds summer/fall.
practical.best_start: Lake Louise shoreline stroll → one viewpoint → town if energy
practical.season_note: Peak July–Sept; winter icewalks different trip.

name: Jasper National Park
tagline: Jasper — townsite paths and a lake or canyon short stop.
blurb: Quieter Rockies day than Banff — one valley slice near town.
slice: Jasper townsite / nearby lake or canyon short
art: Jasper National Park mountain valley turquoise river and evergreen forest empty vista

practical.transit_note: Jasper town is the hub; Icefields Parkway is a separate long drive.
practical.best_start: Visitor centre → short lakeshore or canyon walk
practical.season_note: Summer peak; winter cold and services thinner.

name: Yoho National Park
tagline: Yoho — Emerald Lake easy shore path; not a full alpine scramble.
blurb: BC Rockies jewel — shoreline loop around Emerald Lake.
art: Yoho Emerald Lake bright green glacial water and mountain ring empty shore

practical.energy_note: Easy shore path; water is icy.
practical.best_start: Emerald Lake shore circuit (as open) → picnic eyes

name: Plitvice Lakes National Park
tagline: Plitvice — boardwalk lakes and waterfalls; one entrance loop, not every trail.
blurb: Croatia’s turquoise lakes — boardwalk day with stairs and crowds.
slice: Upper or Lower lakes boardwalk circuit (pick one entrance plan)
art: Plitvice Lakes turquoise cascading lakes wooden boardwalks empty landscape golden light

practical.ticket_note: Timed tickets often required; buy ahead in peak season.
practical.transit_note: Two main entrances; buses from Zagreb/Zadar.
practical.energy_note: Lots of walking and stairs; strollers hard on boardwalks.
practical.best_start: Ticketed entry → boardwalk lake circuit → exit shuttle if offered
practical.season_note: Peak summer crowded; shoulder seasons nicer.

name: Eryri (Snowdonia) National Park
tagline: Eryri/Snowdonia — Llanberis lake and valley views; summit only if energy and weather allow.
blurb: North Wales mountain day — lakeshore and valley, not a forced summit.
art: Snowdonia Welsh mountains slate green valley and lake empty landscape

practical.ticket_note: Park free to enter; railway/parking fees separate.
practical.transit_note: Llanberis is a classic family base.
practical.energy_note: Weather turns fast; wet rock is slippery.

name: Lake District National Park
tagline: Lake District — Derwentwater shore or similar easy lakeside; not every fell.
blurb: England’s lakes — one shoreline stroll and a view.
art: Lake District calm lake reflection green fells and soft English light empty shore

practical.transit_note: Keswick or Windermere towns as hubs.
practical.energy_note: Mud and rain common; easy shore paths exist.
practical.best_start: Lakeshore path → jetty views → town treat
practical.season_note: Summer busy; winter wet and dark early.

name: Killarney National Park
tagline: Killarney — Muckross shore and woodland paths; not a full Ring of Kerry day.
blurb: Ireland’s lakes and woods — one shore loop near Muckross.
art: Killarney National Park green Irish lakes mountains and woodland empty shore

practical.energy_note: Rain likely; paths can be muddy.

name: Fuji-Hakone-Izu National Park
tagline: Fuji area — lakeshore views of the mountain; not a summit climb.
blurb: Japan icon day — Kawaguchiko shore views when Fuji is out.
slice: Kawaguchiko / Fuji five lakes shore view
art: Mount Fuji snowy cone reflected in calm lake with autumn colors empty shore Japan

practical.transit_note: Kawaguchiko is the classic family view base; weather may hide Fuji.
practical.energy_note: Easy shore paths; cold wind off the lake.
practical.best_start: Lakeshore promenade → Fuji viewpoint → onsen town rest
practical.season_note: Clear winter views often best; summer hazy.

name: Nikkō National Park
tagline: Nikkō — lake and waterfall short stops; shrines nearby are separate tickets.
blurb: Tochigi mountains — Chuzenji lake or a waterfall stop plus forest air.
art: Nikko mountain lake cedar forest and waterfall mist Japan empty landscape

practical.transit_note: Nikko town + buses up to Chuzenji.
practical.best_start: Lake shore or waterfall stop → forest path

name: Fiordland National Park
tagline: Fiordland — Milford Sound lookout or Te Anau short; not a multi-day track.
blurb: NZ fiords — one lookout day if weather and road allow.
slice: Milford Sound viewing area / Te Anau edge
art: Fiordland misty sheer cliffs dark water and waterfall empty dramatic fiord

practical.ticket_note: Park free; cruises and parking extra.
practical.transit_note: Long drive Te Anau–Milford; weather closes road sometimes.
practical.best_start: If road open: lookout/shore views; else Te Anau lakeshore
practical.season_note: Summer busiest; winter ice on road.

name: Blue Mountains National Park
tagline: Blue Mountains — Three Sisters lookout and a short cliff-top walk.
blurb: Near Sydney — eucalyptus haze views and one famous overlook.
art: Blue Mountains Three Sisters sandstone cliffs blue eucalyptus haze empty lookout

practical.transit_note: Katoomba / Echo Point; train from Sydney possible.
practical.best_start: Echo Point lookout → short cliff walk as open

name: Kruger National Park
tagline: Kruger — rest-camp and short paved loop day; wildlife never guaranteed.
blurb: Safari park day — camp paths and a slow drive loop if you have a vehicle.
slice: Rest camp + nearby tar road short loop
art: Kruger golden savanna acacia trees and distant wildlife silhouettes empty landscape no people

practical.ticket_note: SANParks conservation fees; gates close strictly.
practical.transit_note: Self-drive or guided; rest camps are the safe base.
practical.energy_note: Heat; never leave vehicle except in camps; malaria risk in some seasons.
practical.best_start: Rest camp paths → short tar loop with adult driving → back before gate time
practical.season_note: Dry season often better wildlife viewing; always soft expectations.

name: Table Mountain National Park
tagline: Table Mountain — cableway top paths or Signal Hill/shore alternative if wind closes cable.
blurb: Cape Town icon — summit boardwalks when the cableway runs.
slice: Cableway upper station paths (or shore alternative)
art: Table Mountain flat-topped massif over Cape Town ocean golden light empty mountain

practical.ticket_note: Cableway tickets separate; park areas fee zones.
practical.transit_note: Cape Town; wind often stops cableway — have a backup.
practical.best_start: If cable open: upper paths + views; else coastal park stretch
practical.season_note: Summer windy; check cable status morning-of.

name: Torres del Paine National Park
tagline: Torres del Paine — a mirador or lakeshore short; not the W trek.
blurb: Patagonia towers — one viewpoint day when weather allows.
slice: Mirador / lakeshore short (not full W circuit)
art: Torres del Paine granite towers turquoise lake Patagonia empty dramatic landscape

practical.ticket_note: CONAF entry tickets; book peak season.
practical.transit_note: From Puerto Natales; long bus/transfer day.
practical.energy_note: Fierce wind; cold; weather cancels views often.
practical.best_start: Park entry → one official mirador or shore stop → back before dark
practical.season_note: Austral summer peak; shoulder seasons windy.

name: Iguazú National Park (Argentina)
tagline: Iguazú — boardwalk circuits to the falls; one side’s paths, not both countries in one rush.
blurb: Thundering falls — boardwalk day on the Argentina circuits.
art: Iguazu Falls massive cascading water jungle mist empty boardwalk viewpoint landscape

practical.ticket_note: Park entry tickets; train inside park optional fee.
practical.transit_note: Puerto Iguazú gateway; Brazil side is a separate park/day.
practical.best_start: Enter → boardwalk circuits toward Garganta viewpoints as open
